Label: GPU inference server with used NVIDIA T4 cards (2018 generation, new host), scaled to 1 kW
Status: variant: refurbished hardware (lever D, T-35); not the case's reference server; the reference house keeps the abstract 1 kW server of config/reference-house.json for scored figures
Description: One host (R570 class, new, as gpu-inference-l4) plus 12.0 used 70 W T4 cards. The T4 is the L4's predecessor (same power, about 2.5x less inference work per kWh) and has a deep used market. Wear and failure cost: config/hardware/wear/refurbished-wear.json.
TranscriptionModel: whisper-large-v3-turbo (GPU), L4 benchmark scaled by the T4/L4 throughput ratio

UnitElectricKw.source: NVIDIA T4 board power 70 W (stated in https://forums.developer.nvidia.com/t/tesla-t4-consumes-more-than-70watt/127304 and comparison pages such as https://www.clarifai.com/blog/t4-vs-l4; https://servethehome.com/nvidia-tesla-t4-ai-inferencing-gpu-review/5 measured 74 W at full load, 36 W idle; search snippets, accessed 2026-11-21, medium; TODO(source): NVIDIA T4 datasheet)

UnitPurchasePriceChf.source: derived: USD 545 x 0.8402 CHF/USD; USD 545 = midpoint of the AMCompute appraisal of realised used sales USD 510-580 over 12 months to Aug 2026 (https://www.amcompute.com/appraisals/tesla-t4, search snippet, accessed 2026-11-21, medium); eBay asks USD 430-700 (https://www.ebay.com/shop/nvidia-t4)

HostElectricKw.source: same estimate as config/hardware/cpu-server.json UnitElectricKw (Xeon 6507P TDP + memory)

HostPurchasePriceChf.source: data/raw/market/costs.csv cost-server-dell-r570 (new host kept; a refurbished host would cut this, see docs/research/refurbished-hardware.md §5)

ServerElectricKw.source: docs/case/challenge.md: rack-server reference (1 kW), used as normalisation

IdleElectricKw.source: derived: 11.9643 cards x 36 W idle (servethehome.com T4 review, snippet, medium, one card) + host 0.1625 kW x 0.205 idle ratio (config/hardware/cpu-server.json) = 0.431 + 0.033; nearly half of full load, so non-heating hours need hard power-off

HeatRecoveryShare.source: docs/case/challenge.md: 80 percent recoverable into water (assumes liquid cooling; T4 cards are passively air-cooled)

LifetimeYears.source: derived: value-weighted life so that purchase / life = cards / 3 years + host / 6 years = 5478.55 / 3 + 8248.03 / 6 = CHF 3200.86 per year; 3 years remaining for used cards (assumption, docs/research/refurbished-hardware.md §4), 6 years for the new host (lifetime-coreweave-technology-accounting)

OpsChfPerServerYear.source: derived: 1 host x CHF 59 per server-month x 12 (data/raw/market/costs.csv cost-ops-smartsolution-server-basic); expected failure cost NOT included, see config/hardware/wear/refurbished-wear.json

TranscriptionAudioHoursPerServerHour.source: derived: 11.9643 cards x 40.4 audio h per L4-hour (hw-perf-e2e-l4-whisper-turbo-b4, low) x 0.4 T4/L4 throughput ratio (NVIDIA: L4 2.5x T4 generative AI, nvidia.com/l4; arXiv 2604.14552 ResNet FP16 about 2.3x; snippets, medium); not measured on a T4, TODO(source)

WebhostingSitesPerServer.source: TODO(source): GPUs add nothing to webhosting; host CPU only

SpotPriceChfPerServerHour.source: derived: 11.9643 x CHF 0.2663 AWS g4dn.xlarge (1 T4 + 4 vCPU) spot eu-central-1 (data/raw/market/compute-prices.csv cp-gpu-aws-g4dn-xlarge-euc1-spot, medium); rental price per GPU-hour, NOT per unit of work: per unit of work a T4 is worth about 0.4 L4, see docs/research/refurbished-hardware.md §5

OnDemandPriceChfPerServerHour.source: derived: 11.9643 x CHF 0.5529 AWS g4dn.xlarge on-demand eu-central-1 (cp-gpu-aws-g4dn-xlarge-euc1-od, medium)

HomeHostPriceChfPerServerHour.source: derived: spot 3.186 x RunPod L4 community/datacentre ratio 0.64 (docs/research/computing-price.md C1 method; no T4 marketplace row sourced, assumption)
